name: "Spinach & Artichoke Dip" Melts with Crunchy Mixed Veggie Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 crown broccoli
½ bunch radish
½ orange bell pepper
1 (5 oz) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; place in a medium bowl along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp red wine vinegar
1 tsp Dijon mustard
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and thinly slice radishes; trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add both to the bowl and stir to combine the salad; set aside.
Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover with a lid and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Once the water in the pan is boiling, uncover; add salt and spinach. Stir until wilted, 30-60 seconds, then drain in a colander and rinse with cold water to cool.
Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then transfer to a cutting board. Roughly chop spinach and place in a small bowl.
Drain and roughly chop artichokes; add to the bowl with the spinach along with mayo and spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (6 oz) jar artichoke hearts, marinated
2 tbsp mayonnaise
½ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp crushed red pepper
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice cream cheese and add to the bowl with the spinach mixture; stir to combine the "dip" and set aside.
Arrange bread slices on a baking sheet pan and drizzle with oil. Place in the oven and broil until toasted, about 1 minute; remove from oven.
Divide "dip" between toast slices and top with Parmesan. Return to the oven and broil until cheese is melted and golden, about 2 minutes; remove from oven.
To serve, divide melts and salad between plates. Enjoy!
